what: Web sources lane F3's tolerance stack-up rests on, archived so every band can be re-read offline. Two of the five rows are records of a FAILED fetch and are labelled NOT A SOURCE.

assets.note: Protolabs Network / Hubs 'Manufacturing standards'. The page the FDM-A and FDM-B tolerance bands in sim/tolerance_stack.py are quoted from, byte for byte as served. Verbatim in the archived file: 'The acceptable accuracy of parts varies by technology and is stated as: Material Dimensional accuracy Prototyping FDM: +/- 0.5% with a lower limit of +/- 0.5 mm (+/- 0.02") Industrial FDM: +/- 0.3% with a lower limit: +/- 0.3 mm (+/-0.012" in)'. Archived because the study rested on it and grep found the URL in exactly two places -- the script and its own output -- so it could not be re-verified offline.

Published ISO 286-1:2010(E) standard tolerance grades IT01..IT18 for nominal sizes to 3150 mm. The page's own reference line reads 'ISO - International Organization for Standardization ISO 286-1 - 2010(E)'. Every IT band in sim/tolerance_stack.py is transcribed from this table (PUBLISHED_IT_UM); the cube-root derivation is kept only as a self-test against it. Row '10 18' IT16 reads 1,1 mm = 1100 um, which is what the earlier version of the study mis-stated as 'coarser than'.

Wei X, Zhang S, Sun L, Zhao X, Sun M, Yu R, Zhou X, Li Y (2025), 'Geometric Accuracy and Dimensional Precision in 3D Printing-Based Gear Manufacturing: A Study on Interchangeability and Forming Precision', Polymers 17(3):416, doi 10.3390/polym17030416, CC BY. The MEASURED print-accuracy study the lane brief allowed as the alternative to a vendor spec; source of the FDM-D band. Verbatim: 'deviations for large and pinion gears ranging between -0.045 and 0.060 mm, and -0.150 and 0.078 mm, respectively'; 'all geometric feature tolerances fell within the IT09-IT11 range'; 'The FDM process was performed using the MakerBot(R) Replicator(TM) 2X 3D printer'; 'Polylactic acid (PLA) polymer (model: 6252D, density: 1.24 x 10^3 kg/m^3)'.

NOT A SOURCE. The record of a failed fetch: bambulab.com serves a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge to curl and returns 403 to WebFetch, and wiki.bambulab.com/en/h2s/manual/h2s-specifications answers 'Page Not Found'. Kept so the attempt to find the farm's own printer spec is on disk rather than only in a transcript. What Bambu does publish for the H2S is MOTION accuracy ('under 50 um' distance-independent, WITH the optional Vision Encoder) and 'Auto Hole/Contour Compensation' -- neither is a part dimensional tolerance, so FDM-C stays CANNOT DETERMINE.
NOT A SOURCE. 3295-byte 'Page Not Found | Bambu Lab Wiki'. Kept for the same reason as the row above.
